description: Facilitates the Frame movement of a Tutti design session. Use after the Constitution movement to pin who the project is for, why they care the day it ships, the appetite (a fixed time or cost budget, not an estimate), and what is explicitly out of scope. Asks one question at a time and emits the movement artifact section once the customer, problem, appetite, and non-goals are all covered.
